records.title: OracleKV: Oracle Guidance for Question-Independent KV Cache Eviction
records.reason: Uses dialogue-derived preference guidance to select KV-cache entries without future queries, targeting memory and computation costs in long-context LLM inference.

records.title: Global Resolution: Optimal Multi-Draft Speculative Sampling via Convex Minimization
records.reason: Reformulates multi-draft speculative sampling as a tractable convex optimization problem to improve token acceptance and autoregressive decoding efficiency.

records.title: DecDEC: A Systems Approach to Advancing Low-Bit LLM Quantization
records.reason: Fetches residuals for salient activation-outlier channels during decoding to recover low-bit quantized LLM quality with minimal memory and latency overhead.

records.title: X-former Elucidator: Reviving Efficient Attention for Long Context Language Modeling
records.reason: Survey and evaluation of efficient-attention alternatives for long-context LLM development and deployment, comparing efficiency, effectiveness, and tradeoffs.

records.title: Predicting Quantization Price for Selecting PTQ Configurations Before Deployment
records.reason: Prices layer-output quantization error against downstream curvature and deployment cost to choose among PTQ formats/configurations before deployment.

records.title: Trellis: Learning to Compress Key-Value Memory in Attention Models
records.reason: Introduces bounded, fixed-size KV memory updated by online recurrent compression, addressing Transformer attention memory growth for long sequences.

records.title: Don't Pay Attention
records.reason: Introduces Avey, a ranker plus autoregressive processor that selectively contextualizes relevant tokens, aiming to avoid quadratic attention costs and support efficient long sequences.

records.title: Lookahead Q-Cache: Achieving More Consistent KV Cache Eviction via Pseudo Query
records.reason: Uses inexpensive pseudo lookahead queries to align cache-eviction importance with decoding queries, improving quality under constrained LLM KV-cache budgets.

records.title: Toward Sustainable Distributed LLM Inference: A Systems Synthesis and Research Agenda for an Energy-, Carbon-, and Cache-Aware llm-d Control Plane
records.reason: Synthesizes serving-system evidence into an energy-, carbon-, cache-, and SLO-aware distributed inference control-plane agenda for routing and scaling LLM deployments.

records.title: DeciMamba: Exploring the Length Extrapolation Potential of Mamba
records.reason: Introduces a context-extension method for Mamba that improves extrapolation to longer inputs without additional training while retaining faster inference.

records.title: STAT: Shrinking Transformers After Training
records.reason: Prunes attention heads and neurons after training using matrix factorizations and weight correction, compressing BERT and decoder LLMs with limited accuracy loss.

records.title: Fuzzy Speculative Decoding for a Tunable Accuracy-Runtime Tradeoff
records.reason: Generalizes speculative decoding by accepting controlled distribution divergence, explicitly trading a small quality change for faster LLM generation.

records.title: HCSpec: Two-Tier Horizontal Cascade Speculative Decoding for High-Efficiency Large Language Model Inference
records.reason: Uses heterogeneous position-specialized draft modules in a two-tier cascade to improve acceptance efficiency and end-to-end speculative LLM decoding speed.

records.title: Speculative Sampling with Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Applies context-aware reinforcement learning to adjust speculative draft-tree hyperparameters in real time, improving inference speed while preserving output fidelity.

records.title: TriAxialKV: Toward Extreme Low-Precision KV-Cache Quantization for Agentic Inference Tasks
records.reason: Assigns mixed KV-cache precision using temporal, modality, and semantic-role tags, enabling larger cache capacity and throughput for agentic LLM inference.

records.title: Omni-LUT: Energy-Efficient LUT-Based Accelerator with Hardware-Aware KV Cache Quantization
records.reason: Co-designs LUT GEMM hardware and KV-cache quantization for attention and linear layers, targeting lower energy use in long-context LLM inference.

records.title: A Case for a Simulation-Driven Exploration of Distributed GenAI Platforms
records.reason: Presents Opal, a discrete-event simulator to explore cross-layer hardware, scheduling, and workload tradeoffs in distributed GenAI inference platforms.

records.title: DimPO: Dimensionality Reduction for Attention using Preference Optimization
records.reason: Learns low-dimensional query/key projections from attention preference signals to reduce attention dimensions while retaining task-relevant behavior.

records.title: Characterizing Performance-Energy Trade-offs of Large Language Models in Multi-Request Workflows
records.reason: Characterizes latency, throughput, and energy in multi-request LLM workflows and identifies batching and power controls as workload-dependent serving levers.

records.title: APB: Accelerating Distributed Long-Context Inference by Passing Compressed Context Blocks across GPUs
records.reason: Uses compressed context blocks and multi-host approximate attention to reduce prefill compute and communication overhead for distributed long-context inference.
